mapper.select: SELECT m.ID FROM medicos m WHERE m.ID = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.ID AS id, m.Nombre AS nombre, m.Apellidos AS apellidos, m.Activo AS activo FROM medicos m JOIN guardias_servicios_medicos sm ON sm.IdMedico = m.ID WHERE sm.IdServicio = #{servicioId} AND m.Activo = 1 ORDER BY m.Apellidos, m.Nombre
